description: Na₃BSbAsO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.78 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.58 Å. B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.33-1.44 Å. Sb is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.31 Å. As is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.69-1.75 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na, one B, and one Sb atom to form distorted ONa₃BSb trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂SbAs trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃BSb trigonal bipyramid, edges with two equivalent ONa₂SbAs trigonal pyramids, and  a faceface with one ONa₃BSb trigonal bipyramid. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na, one B, and one Sb atom to form distorted ONa₃BSb trigonal bipyramids that share corners with six equivalent ONa₂SbAs trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃BSb trigonal bipyramid, and  a faceface with one ONa₃BSb trigonal bipyramid. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Sb, and one As atom to form distorted ONa₂SbAs trigonal pyramids that share corners with four ONa₃BSb trigonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂SbAs trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃BSb trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂SbAs trigonal pyramid. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Na and one As atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sb, and one As atom.
